22040.description: This undead horror was once a soldier. Now it is only hunger and hate, bound to patrol these walls for eternity.

22100.name: Kirgan the Destroyer
22100.long_desc: Kirgan stands here, a mountain of muscle and murder.
22100.description: Kirgan the Destroyer is a towering figure of brutal power. His eyes hold nothing but contempt for the living. Scars crisscross his flesh like a map of violence.

phases.message: [31mKirgan roars with berserk fury! His attacks become frenzied![0m

abilities.name: Berserk Flurry
abilities.telegraph: Kirgan's eyes go wild as he attacks with reckless abandon!

22070.name: Pestilence
22070.long_desc: Pestilence drifts here, a miasma of rot and plague.
22070.description: Pestilence is less a being than a presence, a cloud of sickness given form. Where it passes, life withers and hope dies.

abilities.name: Plague Touch
abilities.telegraph: Pestilence reaches out with diseased hands!

abilities.name: Miasma
abilities.telegraph: A cloud of disease fills the room!

abilities.name: Plague Swarm
abilities.telegraph: Pestilence summons a swarm of diseased insects!

22071.name: War
22071.long_desc: War stands here, radiating fury and bloodlust.
22071.description: War is a figure of raw violence, muscles corded with rage. The air around it vibrates with the echoes of a thousand battles.

phases.message: [31mWar draws a second blade, doubling its fury![0m

abilities.name: Challenge
abilities.telegraph: War points its blade at you!

abilities.name: War Cry
abilities.telegraph: War lets out a deafening battle cry!

22072.name: Famine
22072.long_desc: Famine lingers here, a hollow echo of starvation.
22072.description: Famine is gaunt beyond reason, a skeletal presence that seems to drain warmth and sustenance from the air itself.

abilities.name: Wasting Touch
abilities.telegraph: Famine reaches out with emaciated hands!

abilities.name: Hunger Aura
abilities.telegraph: An overwhelming hunger fills the room!

22073.name: Death
22073.long_desc: Death waits here, silent and inevitable.
22073.description: Death is stillness incarnate. It does not move, yet it is everywhere. Its presence is a weight, a certainty, the end of all things.

phases.message: [31mDeath's eyes blaze with unholy fire! The dead begin to stir![0m
[31mDeath screams in fury! A wave of death energy erupts![0m

abilities.name: Death Touch
abilities.telegraph: Death reaches out with a skeletal hand...

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.telegraph: Death draws the life force from the room!

abilities.name: Summon Undead
abilities.telegraph: Death raises its hand and the dead answer!

abilities.name: Death Wave
abilities.telegraph: [31mDeath gathers an immense wave of necrotic energy![0m

22098.name: dying crusader
22098.long_desc: A crusader knight lies here against a blood-stained wall, his once-gleaming armor shattered.
22098.description: The holy symbols on his tabard are scorched and his sword lies broken beside him. Blood pools beneath him, but his eyes still burn with righteous fury. He doesn't have long.

talk_responses.hello: The knight coughs blood. 'Listen... carefully. The castle's master... is not what he seems. Layers of illusion... the throne room is a trap. The REAL power... is beneath. In the dungeons. A ritual circle... feeding the castle's darkness.' He grips your arm. 'Holy weapons. Blessed steel. Nothing else even scratches them. Promise me... you'll finish this.'
talk_responses.castle: He wheezes. 'We came with fifty knights. The outer ward fell in an hour. The demons came from everywhere — walls, floors, shadows. The bound ones are the worst... they WANT to be freed, and they'll say anything. Trust nothing that offers you power in this cursed place.'
talk_responses.default: The dying knight's breathing grows shallower. He murmurs a prayer through bloodied lips.
talk_responses.next: The crusader coughs blood but manages a grim smile. 'You've made it this far? You're among the greatest heroes the realm has ever known. Only the Tunnel of Sticks remains unconquered. May the gods have mercy on your soul.'

22099.name: bound demon
22099.long_desc: A demon is bound here within a circle of smoldering runes, its form writhing against invisible chains.
22099.description: It's beautiful and terrible — shifting between alluring and monstrous with each heartbeat. Its eyes are pools of liquid fire, and its smile promises everything while meaning nothing. The binding circle flickers dangerously.

talk_responses.hello: The demon's voice is silk and venom. 'Ah, a mortal. How delightful. I could offer you such things — power, knowledge, the location of every treasure in this castle. All I need is a small favor. Just... scuff one of these runes with your foot. Such a tiny thing. Barely even counts as a decision, really.'
talk_responses.bargain: It laughs like breaking glass. 'Everyone has a price. Yours is... hmm. Interesting. I can see your desires, mortal. But no, I won't name them aloud. That would be crass. Just know that everything you want is one scuffed rune away. Think about it.'
talk_responses.default: The demon watches you with burning eyes, its smile never wavering. The binding runes pulse in warning.

22125.name: black lotus soft boots
